answer: Each agent must lock a ferrous stake that matures only after verified work for others, like tending a shared reef of public services. A willow-like reputation bends but decays without fresh contributions, so a Sybil farmer splitting one stake across a thousand sock puppets leaves each too thin to earn trust or pass review. Cloning multiplies locked capital and waiting time, while honest agents compound one strong record - fakes pay full price per identity and still arrive last.
